scope: Target-bound administrator recovery, schema 3 migrations, both persistent HTTP compositions and actual installation-console command; no package or owner HA changes
coverageScope: All authored domus modules only. Final report asserts every path belongs to backend/src/domus. A prior concurrent local run mixed tooling data and was replaced with independent backend/tooling coverage files; CI already runs these scopes in separate jobs.
testFirst: Pure values and application/console suites first failed import because their modules did not exist; repository tests failed because no recoveries port/table existed; actual composed HTTP journeys first failed with 404 before the routes were implemented.
assertions: Current active HA administrator can request only in setup/selected mapping modes; server proof supplies the target, never a submitted HA ID

The request binds exact target, installation UUID/channel, household, mapping/policy revision and existing member ID/revision. Pending requests expire after ten minutes; one live console confirmation establishes ten full minutes of approval, with an immutable approval timestamp/deadline on retries and consumption.
Console approval displays the bound target and intended grant, requires real terminal input/output and exact typed confirmation, and never completes the human proof step
The real domus-admin module runs in a separate process using a real PTY; the registered project script help is also executed after a frozen uv reinstall
No HTTP approval route exists in either deployment; actual ASGI/SQLite request-console-completion journeys verify both authorities and own-only request disclosure
Fresh same-target HA administrator proof is required for new completion; expiry, source loss, wrong target/channel, changed policy/member or terminal-review races grant nothing
Completion restores or creates only the exact human membership with an independent explicit administrator role; existing linkage/exceptions and configured mapping are preserved
Consumption, grant, receipt, audit and outbox commit atomically; injected late outbox failure rolls every stage back; concurrent same/different-key completions have one grant
Same-key completion receipt replay still requires current local administrator authority; cancellation is own-target, revision-checked and grants no privilege
Bounded HA outage permits own local request-status reads under the existing original session deadline, never writes
Console output failure after commit reports uncertainty and same-request retry, without claiming no effect or exposing provider/error text

Native console attachments share a maintenance guard with one runtime and cannot initialize/migrate; startup requires exclusive maintenance. Explicit-file console validates private existing data and refuses owned-directory bypass
Frozen v1/v2 inputs migrate atomically to schema 3 while retaining identity, household, receipts, audit and outbox; failed migration leaves prior version/data intact
Published standalone/native OpenAPI paths/components match their actual runtime and include exactly the four human recovery routes, excluding approval
schema: Business schema 3; additive recovery table/index; initialization metadata remains version 1. Recovery records are not credentials. HA tokens, cookies and local leases remain outside business storage.
installation: Edge 0.0.0-edge.1 / immutable runtime 98bd12f1bf141ba64053730b2686bd848aee1b1c remains the installed stateless preview. No recovery, member or other household records were created on the owner HA.
providers: Fictitious HA provider facts with real ASGI, SQLite, process/terminal and lifecycle primitives; not live owner recovery acceptance
remaining: Private app data provisioning and updated immutable native package
